name: n8n
shortDescription: Workflow automation you can self-host for free, or use n8n Cloud on a paid plan.
longDescription: n8n automates workflows across apps, including agent-style steps. Community Edition is the free self-host path. n8n Cloud’s Starter plan was listed at 20€/month on annual billing, with a card-free trial rather than a permanent free cloud tier.
pricingNotes: Cloud Starter was listed at 20 euros per month on annual billing, which is not a USD monthly price, so startingPrice stays null. Community Edition is the free self-host option.
bestFor: Multi-step workflows across apps you already use
notIdealFor: A permanent free cloud plan, which is not listed
strength: Community Edition is a free self-host option for multi-step workflows across the apps you already use.
weakness: Cloud Starter was listed at 20 euros per month on annual billing, with a card-free trial rather than a permanent free cloud plan.
smokeTestNotes: Registry, docs, and pricing were reviewed.

useCaseFit.workflow-automation: Self-hosted community edition for multi-step workflows across apps you already use.
